nodes.summary: The adjoint of the composition operator is the fiber-sum operator: `((C_ψ)† y) m` is the sum of `y` over the fiber of `m`.
nodes.title: Adjoint of a composition operator is the fiber-sum operator

nodes.summary: The adjoint of the composition operator for a permutation symbol is the composition operator of the inverse permutation.
nodes.title: Adjoint of a composition operator with a permutation symbol

nodes.summary: Pointwise action of the composition operator.
nodes.title: Pointwise action of the bounded composition operator

nodes.summary: Composition of composition operators is composition of symbols in the reversed order: `C_φ ∘L C_ψ = C_{ψ ∘ φ}`.
nodes.title: Composition of composition operators

nodes.summary: If `ψ` is pointwise the identity, `C_ψ` is the identity operator.
nodes.title: Composition operator of a pointwise identity symbol

nodes.summary: `C_id` is the identity operator.
nodes.title: Composition operator of the identity is the identity

nodes.summary: A permutation symbol gives a unitary composition operator.
nodes.title: Permutation composition operators are unitary

nodes.summary: The composition operator as a bounded operator on `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)`.
nodes.title: Bounded composition operator on $\ell^2$

nodes.summary: The composition function: precompose a sequence with `ψ`.
nodes.title: Precomposition of a sequence with a map

nodes.summary: Pointwise action of the composition linear map.
nodes.title: Pointwise action of the composition linear map

nodes.summary: The composition operator as a linear map.
nodes.title: Composition operator as a linear map

nodes.summary: On its finite domain, the fiber count agrees with the standard natural cardinality.
nodes.title: Fiber count agrees with set cardinality

nodes.summary: The number of preimages of `m` under `ψ`, defined for a finite fiber.
nodes.title: Fiber cardinality of a map

nodes.summary: On its bounded finite domain, the fiber supremum agrees with the supremum of natural cardinalities. Its value is independent of the chosen bound and evidence.
nodes.title: Fiber supremum as a supremum of cardinalities

nodes.summary: `fiberSup ψ hψ` is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Fiber supremum is nonnegative

nodes.summary: The real supremum of the fiber counts of `ψ`, defined for uniformly bounded finite fibers. The bound in `hψ` ensures that the real-valued family is bounded above.
nodes.title: Supremum of the fiber counts of a map

nodes.summary: Fiber bounds compose: the fibers of `ψ ∘ φ` are bounded by the product of the bounds.
nodes.title: Bounded fibers are preserved under composition

nodes.summary: Halving pairs: the map `n ↦ n / 2` has fibers of size at most two.
nodes.title: Halving map has fibers of size at most two

nodes.summary: A permutation symbol has fibers of size one.
nodes.title: Permutations have fibers of size one

nodes.summary: An injective symbol has fibers of size at most one.
nodes.title: Injective maps have fibers of size at most one

nodes.summary: The fibers of `ψ` are finite and uniformly bounded by `M`: every value is taken at most `M` times. This is the boundedness hypothesis for the composition operator.
nodes.title: Uniformly bounded fibers of a map on the naturals

nodes.summary: `C_ψ` is injective iff `ψ` is surjective: a missing value gives a basis vector in the kernel, and a surjective symbol lets every coordinate be read off from the image.
nodes.title: Composition operator is injective iff its symbol is surjective

nodes.summary: The composed sequence of an `ℓ²` sequence is in `ℓ²`, under the bounded fibers hypothesis.
nodes.title: Precomposition preserves square-summability

nodes.summary: The composition operator is bounded by `√(fiberSup ψ hψ)` on every vector.
nodes.title: Vectorwise norm bound for the composition operator

nodes.summary: The operator norm of `C_ψ` is at most `√(fiberSup ψ hψ)`.
nodes.title: Operator-norm bound for the composition operator

nodes.summary: The norm of `C_ψ` applied to a standard basis vector is the square root of the corresponding fiber count.
nodes.title: Norm of the composition operator on a basis vector

nodes.summary: The operator norm of the composition operator: `‖C_ψ‖ = √(fiberSup ψ hψ)`, the square root of the largest fiber count.
nodes.title: Operator norm of a composition operator

nodes.summary: The composition operator is bounded by `√(fiberSup ψ hψ)`.
nodes.title: Norm bound for the composition linear map

nodes.summary: The squared norm of `C_ψ x` is at most `fiberSup ψ hψ * ‖x‖²`.
nodes.title: Squared-norm bound for the composition linear map

nodes.summary: A composition operator on `ℓ²(ℕ, 𝕜)` is never compact: the images of the basis vectors indexed by the (necessarily infinite) range of `ψ` are pairwise orthogonal and bounded below in norm, so they have no Cauchy subsequence.
nodes.title: Composition operators on $\ell^2$ are never compact

nodes.summary: `C_ψ` is surjective iff `ψ` is injective: if `ψ a = ψ b` with `a ≠ b`, the `a`-th and `b`-th coordinates of every vector in the range agree, so `e_a` is not in the range; if `ψ` is injective, the preimage of `y` is obtained by applying the adjoint and reading off the fiber sums.
nodes.title: Composition operator is surjective iff its symbol is injective

nodes.summary: The squared-norm sum of the composed sequence is at most `fiberSup ψ hψ` times the squared-norm sum of the original sequence.
nodes.title: Squared-norm sum bound for a precomposed sequence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
